target: Rookie WR route-speed capacity: per-player 90th percentile of route 95th-percentile speeds, snap+1s through release, >=30 routes
inputs: pre-draft only; body/timed/NGS, plus common conventional late-speed proxy 30/(forty-ten_yd_split) and initial-acceleration proxy 20/ten_yd_split^2
tracked_features: sensor .95 quantile speed before4.5s, mean3–4s, early .5–1.5s/ceiling ratio; repeated attempt medians
selection: 4 outer,3 inner earlier-player folds; 2023 train/2024 validation then earlier-year refit/2025 exploratory; identical ridge1/10/100 and depth3 forest bank
source_flag: Strong conventional algebraic proxies and forest full feature availability set before inspection of pilot forward results. Pilot retained, not a fair strong-baseline improvement claim.
inference: Global prior2025WR inspection; prospective confirmation requires untouched population. Source linear residualization only uses training players.
